records.title: General Data Protection Regulation — Regulation (EU) 2016/679
records.status: Applicable — territorial scope must be assessed
records.agent_relevance: Indirect but material to AI-enabled processing
records.summary: The GDPR governs processing of personal data within its territorial scope. Its relevance to an AI agent depends on the data, controller/processor roles, processing context and territorial nexus.
records.agent_notes: Agent memory, prompts, retrieval, tool calls, customer profiling and automated decisions may involve personal data. Assess Articles 3, 5, 6, 13–15, 22, 25, 28, 32 and 35 where relevant; do not assume Article 22 applies to every AI-assisted decision.
records.verification_note: Official EUR-Lex consolidated legislation landing page and European Commission data-protection policy page identified. Re-check consolidated text and applicable national supervisory guidance before publication.
records.caveat: This proposed record is a MONAISEC research seed. Territorial scope and individual obligations require case-specific legal analysis.
